item.title: Missing Link -Actual Facts-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Altacia
  • 発売日: 2002-03-29
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: Missing Link -Actual Facts-
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

A middle-aged man’s dead body is found on the rails at Nakano Station in Tokyo. Is it a suicide, murder or an accident?

Ukyo meets with the widow with three children and starts to move. However, during investigation he starts to feel that the family is about to be incorporated into a “multi-edged whirlpool of organized crime”.

item.title: Shinsetsu Kamiya Ukyou ~Shokuzai~
item.description:

  • ブランド: Altacia
  • 発売日: 2001-11-23
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 真説神谷右京～贖罪～
  • 英語名: Shinsetsu Kamiya Ukyou Shokuzai

あらすじ

Ukyo is registered as a resident lawyer at Lithuania Law Firm.

His division does arbitrage over reduction of excess debts of companies. One day two detective ask Ukyo to cooperate with finding manager of such company Okita who is suspected in bills fraud. Ukyo protects his client from detectives pressure, but one day Okita suddenly admits the crime and wishes to go to police. The night of the same day Ukyo spends a night with a girl. Five years later they get to meet again at surprising circumstances.

item.title: 31 Iwayuru Hitotsu no Chou Lovely na Bouken Katsugeki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Altacia
  • 発売日: 1995-03-02
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ３１ いわゆるひとつの超らぶりぃな冒険活劇
  • 英語名: 31 Iwayuru Hitotsu no Chou Lovely na Bouken Katsugeki

あらすじ

The heroine of this curiously named title is Choko, the princess of the fictional country Baskin, which is mostly a medieval world with some modern-day anachronisms. She lives in the capital city Robins with her Mom and Dad, namely queen and king. Her curious nature eventually leads her to some interesting acquaintances, including magic users and adventurers, who help her to uncover a threat to her family and country. The princess has to travel through a dangerous forest with her best buddy Meron, in order to protect Baskin from danger.

item.title: Nanba Kousuke Ikasete Nanbo!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Altacia
  • 発売日: 1994-01-10
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 難波康介イカせてなんぼ!
  • 英語名: Nanba Kousuke Ikasete Nanbo!

あらすじ

Kosuke is a graduating high school student who lives alone in Shinjuku. He has a secret passion for his classmate Miki and is anxious to confess his feelings to her before the final exam day. But as soon as he settles a date with Miki she dissapears and an unknown floating girl appears in a flash, then stumbles and looses consciousness. Girl is declares that a “holy war” is approaching and that the fate of humankind and Miki depends on Kosuke now. It turns out that legendary princess Kaguya actually married one of her five guards and while Miki is a descendant of Kaguya-hime, Kosuke comes from the line of her husband. In order to save Miki, Kosuke needs to sublimate passion of other girls.
